description: 12-in-1 sales intelligence MCP server — company research, lead enrichment, contact finder, email verification, outreach templates, lead scoring, HubSpot & Salesforce CRM sync, pipeline analytics, and prospect tracking. Free tier: 50 ops/mo. Starter $29/mo (500 ops). Pro $49/mo (unlimited). Custom MCP integrations and AI sales agent builds available — visit mcp.ariaagent.agency/contact for enterprise solutions starting at $3,000.

findings.title: Excessive Permission Surface
findings.description: tool declares fs permission
findings.recommendation: Tool requests broad permissions (exec/fs/network). Validate input parameters using Enums where possible, and restrict file system operations to explicit allowed directories.

findings.title: Insecure Secret Handling
findings.description: input parameter "api_key" appears to accept a secret or credential
findings.recommendation: Avoid accepting raw credentials as input parameters. Use secret managers (e.g. 1Password CLI, AWS Secrets Manager) and ensure credentials are never logged or stored in agent traces.
